fields.name: Patron identifier
fields.description: The patron's barcode or other library identifier.

fields.name: Patron identifier
fields.description: Copied from the deposit-account activity request (41).

fields.name: Patron identifier
fields.description: Patron barcode; Polaris also accepts a patron username in this request.

fields.name: Patron identifier
fields.description: Patron barcode. Polaris returns the barcode even when the request used a username.

fields.name: Item identifier
fields.description: The item's barcode or other library identifier.

fields.name: Terminal password
fields.description: Password for the self-check terminal, separate from the login and patron passwords.

fields.name: Patron password
fields.description: The patron's PIN or password.

fields.name: Screen message
fields.description: Text from the library system to display to the user.

fields.name: Print line
fields.description: Text from the library system to print on a receipt.

fields.name: Due date
fields.description: When the checked-out item is due back.

fields.name: Title identifier
fields.description: A title or bibliographic identifier, or the item's title text.

fields.name: Blocked card message
fields.description: The reason supplied when blocking a patron's card.

fields.name: Terminal location
fields.description: The self-check terminal's location supplied by the library system.

fields.name: Institution ID
fields.description: Identifies the library or institution for this transaction.

fields.name: Current location
fields.description: The item's current location or the location handling the transaction.

fields.name: Permanent location
fields.description: The item's normal home or shelving location.

fields.name: Hold items
fields.description: An entry in the patron's list of holds; may repeat for multiple items.

fields.name: Overdue items
fields.description: An entry in the patron's list of overdue items.

fields.name: Charged items
fields.description: An entry in the patron's list of checked-out items.

fields.name: Fine item details
fields.description: Polaris formats can include a transaction ID, outstanding amount, fine type, fee description and related item details.

fields.name: Sequence number
fields.description: A digit from 0 to 9 used to match messages for SIP error detection.

fields.name: Checksum
fields.description: Four hexadecimal digits used to detect transmission errors.

fields.name: Birth date (Polaris)
fields.description: Disclosure of the patron's birth date depends on server configuration.

fields.name: Owner
fields.description: The institution that owns the item.

fields.name: Currency type
fields.description: Three-letter currency code for this payment, such as USD.

fields.name: Cancel
fields.description: Whether this cancels the earlier transaction.

fields.name: Transaction ID
fields.description: An identifier assigned by the library system or payment device for auditing.

fields.name: Notice request value (Polaris)
fields.description: Polaris copies BK from request 43 into response 44 unchanged. Its business meaning is unconfirmed; the response does not generate a notification ID.

fields.name: Echoed request value (Polaris)
fields.description: Polaris copies BK from request 43 into response 44 unchanged. Its business meaning is unconfirmed; the response does not generate a notification ID.

fields.name: Valid patron
fields.description: Whether the library system recognizes the patron.

fields.name: Renewed items
fields.description: An entry identifying an item successfully renewed by Renew all.

fields.name: Unrenewed items
fields.description: An entry for an item that Renew all could not renew; may include a reason.

fields.name: Fee acknowledged
fields.description: Whether the patron accepts the transaction's fee.

fields.name: Start item
fields.description: First detail entry, counting from 1. Polaris requires both BP and BQ to return details.

fields.name: End item
fields.description: Last detail entry, inclusive. Polaris requires both BP and BQ to return details.

fields.name: Queue position
fields.description: The patron's position in the hold queue.

fields.name: Pickup location
fields.description: The location where a hold should be collected.

fields.name: Fee type
fields.description: The type of fee being paid or charged.

fields.name: Recall items
fields.description: An entry in the patron's list of recalled items.

fields.name: Fee amount
fields.description: The amount paid, owed, or charged, depending on the message.

fields.name: Expiration date/time
fields.description: When the hold expires.

fields.name: Supported messages
fields.description: Y means supported; N means not supported.

fields.name: Hold type
fields.description: Whether the hold applies to a title or a particular copy.

values.4: Any copy at one branch or location.

fields.name: Hold items limit
fields.description: Maximum number of holds allowed for this patron.

fields.name: Overdue items limit
fields.description: The patron's permitted overdue-item limit.

fields.name: Charged items limit
fields.description: Maximum number of items the patron may have checked out.

fields.name: Fee limit
fields.description: The patron's permitted outstanding-fee limit.

fields.name: Unavailable hold items
fields.description: An entry for a patron hold that is not yet available.

fields.name: Hold queue length
fields.description: The number of holds waiting for the item.

fields.name: Fee identifier
fields.description: Identifies the particular fee to which a payment should be applied.

fields.name: Item properties
fields.description: Additional item information whose format is agreed with the library system.

fields.name: Security inhibit
fields.description: Whether the terminal should leave the item's security state unchanged.

fields.name: Recall date/time
fields.description: When the recall was issued.

fields.name: Media type
fields.description: The item's material or media format.

fields.name: Sort bin
fields.description: The sorting destination assigned to a returned item.

fields.name: Hold pickup date/time
fields.description: The date by which an available hold should be collected.

fields.name: Login user ID
fields.description: The account used to log in to the SIP server.

fields.name: Login password
fields.description: The password for the SIP login account.

fields.name: Location code
fields.description: The self-check location supplied during login.

fields.name: Location code
fields.description: The self-check location supplied during login.

fields.name: Valid patron password
fields.description: Whether the supplied patron PIN or password is valid.

values.03: Hold for interlibrary loan; listed as unused in the Polaris reference.
values.99: Other alert; listed as unused in the Polaris reference.

fields.name: Vendor profile (legacy Polaris)
fields.description: Polaris 3.6 used CV at login; later versions use VP. The 8.1 reference does not establish CV as a login alias.

fields.name: Next hold patron barcode (Polaris)
fields.description: The next patron in the item's hold queue.

fields.name: Patron credit balance (Polaris)
fields.description: The patron's CreditBalance rendered as signed integer text. Monetary units have not been confirmed. Available when the deposit handler has refreshed patron data; availability is not guaranteed.

fields.name: Patron credit balance (Polaris)
fields.description: The patron's CreditBalance rendered as signed integer text. Monetary units have not been confirmed. Emitted by the EnvisionWare processing branch.

fields.name: Notice comment (extension)
fields.description: Comment sent by this tool's server-specific Notice update command.

fields.name: Accrued fines total (Polaris)
fields.description: The analyzed Polaris 8.1 build truncates the accrued fines total to a 32-bit integer and sends decimal text. Monetary units have not been confirmed.

fields.name: Resolved patron barcode (Polaris)
fields.description: The barcode resolved from the patron record, including when authentication used a username.

fields.name: Internal patron ID (Polaris)
fields.description: The internal Polaris PatronID, serialized as decimal text.

fields.name: Home branch (Polaris)
fields.description: Abbreviation of the patron's registered organization or home branch.

fields.name: Patron expiration date (Polaris)
fields.description: Expiration of the patron's registration, in SIP date/time format.

fields.name: Patron expired (Polaris)
fields.description: Expiration flag based on local end of day in the analyzed 8.1 build. Evaluation can be skipped; N does not establish that registration is current.

fields.name: Patron expired (Polaris)
fields.description: The analyzed Polaris 8.1 build compares local end of day (23:59:59) with the patron's expiration timestamp. Evaluation can be skipped for some patron states and in the EnvisionWare path; exact boundary behavior is unverified.

values.Y: Expiration flag set: local end of day is later than expiration when evaluated.
values.N: Expiration flag clear; the calculation may have been skipped, so N does not establish that registration is current.

fields.name: Internal patron ID (Polaris)
fields.description: PatronID emitted by the EnvisionWare processing branch. It matches PC in the analyzed path; the reason for the duplicate identifier is unconfirmed.

fields.name: Deposit response value (Polaris)
fields.description: The analyzed Polaris 8.1.7065.1 build emits literal decimal 0. The field's broader business meaning has not been established.

fields.name: User1 (Polaris)
fields.description: Patron attribute configured by the library.

fields.name: User2 (Polaris)
fields.description: Patron attribute configured by the library.

fields.name: User3 (Polaris)
fields.description: Patron attribute configured by the library.

fields.name: User4 (Polaris)
fields.description: Patron attribute configured by the library.

fields.name: User5 (Polaris)
fields.description: Patron attribute configured by the library.

fields.name: Vendor profile (extension)
fields.description: Polaris login profile: SIP (1/default), 3M (2), ENVISIONWARE (3), COMPRISE (4), or ITG (5). The analyzed 8.1 parser falls back to SIP for unsupported values.
